deadline.value: No official deadline, but submit by January 1 for the full range of assistantships, scholarships and fellowships; decisions in March.
deadline.quote: Although there is not an official application deadline, applicants for fall semester admissions are encouraged to submit all material by January 1 to be considered for the full range of available assistantships, scholarships, and fellowships.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You are strongly encouraged to contact potential faculty advisors.
supervisor.quote: Students are strongly encouraged to contact potential faculty advisors in their field of interest.

funding.value: The department typically funds all admitted MS and PhD students through research or teaching assistantships with tuition ($2,500 a month pre-candidacy).
funding.quote: The department of Oceanography typically offers financial assistance to all admitted MS and PhD students

entry_route.value: A bachelor's is required; a master's is not needed for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree is a prerequisite for our M.S. and Ph.D. programs, however, individuals do not need a M.S. to apply for the Ph.D. program.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required for admission to the Department

notes: Atmospheric Sciences runs a separate PhD with the same January 1 guidance. Water Management & Hydrological Science (interdisciplinary PhD) pages were unreachable.
name: Oceanography PhD
